story_fr: Vantage Corn Processors a bondi a 127 M$ de resultat operationnel au T1 2026 contre 33 M$ un an plus tot, porte par des marges ethanol en hausse et des mesures incitatives de politique.
story_en: Vantage Corn Processors operating profit jumped to $127M in Q1 2026 from $33M a year earlier, driven by strengthening ethanol margins and policy incentives.
quote: Vantage Corn Processors subsegment operating profit increased by $94 million compared to the prior year quarter, as ADM's corn dry-milling ethanol operations benefited from strengthening ethanol margins, supported by effective risk management and policy incentives

story_fr: Le segment Nutrition a progresse de 42% au T1 2026 (135 M$), tire par les ventes de Flavors, la reprise de l'usine Decatur East et l'amelioration continue de l'Animal Nutrition.
story_en: The Nutrition segment grew 42% in Q1 2026 ($135M), driven by higher Flavors sales, the Decatur East plant recovery and continued Animal Nutrition improvement.
quote: Nutrition business benefiting from higher Flavors sales, the ongoing Decatur East plant recovery, and continued improvements in Animal Nutrition

story_fr: Carbohydrate Solutions a delivre 356 M$ de resultat operationnel au T1 2026, en hausse de 48% sur un an, le meilleur trimestre du segment sur la periode observee.
story_en: Carbohydrate Solutions delivered $356M of operating profit in Q1 2026, up 48% year-over-year, the segment's strongest quarter over the observed period.
quote: Carbohydrate Solutions segment operating profit was $356 million for the first quarter of 2026, an increase of 48% compared to the prior year quarter

story_fr: Au T1 2026, le sous-segment Ag Services a crû de 26% sur un an a 200 M$, soutenu par une activite d'export accrue depuis l'Amerique du Nord, malgre un Crushing en territoire negatif.
story_en: In Q1 2026, the Ag Services subsegment grew 26% year-over-year to $200M, supported by higher North American export activity, despite Crushing turning negative.
quote: Ag Services subsegment operating profit was 26% higher compared to the prior year quarter, supported by higher export activity from North America
